scripts.build:
cat project.b64.* | base64 -d > project.tgz && tar -xzf project.tgz && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('app/page.tsx')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('const asset = (name: string) => `/assets/${name}`;', 'const asset = (name: string) => `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yanekissayabully/quasarsite/main/public/assets/${name}`;')
p.write_text(s)
PY
vite build --config vite.vercel.config.ts
